messages:
Ivy (PM): Quick callout 1: we need a one-page GA acceptance for Project Arrow. Checklist: SLA table, runbook + smoke, oncall rota (72h), monitoring dashboards, and billing/quota test. Can we get a fast thumbs?

Noah (SRE): Proposed SLA: hosted default path P99 <= 300ms for payloads <=512 tokens; availability >= 99.9%. Alerts to be defined.

Tara (Eng): Canary is green on staging. I'll add a 15-min prod canary job and a smoke curl to the runbook.

Omar (FinOps): Billing: need quota->rate-card mapping for pilot tiers and an automated billing smoke (create org, run ~1k tokens, expect invoice webhook). I can run tests if given test org creds.

Noah (SRE): Alert thresholds suggestion:
- perf.p99 > 300ms for 5m -> Sev2
- error.rate > 1% for 5m -> Sev1
- availability < 99.9% for 30m -> Exec page
I'll cover the first 72h with Tara as secondary.

Tara (Eng): Smoke snippet for runbook:
```bash
curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $TEST_KEY" -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -d '{"model":"rwd-v1","input":"smoke"}' | jq .status
```
I'll run it during the canary and after cutover.

Omar (FinOps): Test creds inbound in 45m. I'll post expected invoice JSON and webhook sample here and run pre/post billing smoke.

RunbookBot: Runbook link: https://redwood/internal/runbooks/project-arrow (canary checklist attached).

Ivy (PM): Action owners for signoff doc:
- SLA + exec acceptance: Ivy
- Alerts + oncall rota: Noah
- Canary + runbook + rollback steps: Tara
- Billing smoke + quota mapping: Omar
React with :thumbsup: to accept. No objections by 17:00 PT -> proceed with the deploy window tomorrow.

Tara (Eng): :thumbsup:

Noah (SRE): :thumbsup:

Omar (FinOps): :thumbsup: will post billing results here

Ivy (PM): Thanks all 1  assembling final signoff now and will ping execs after successful smoke.
